g.text: Module 1 - Authentication, Registration and Invoice Generation (Dinuka)
Amount is read from Visal's provider earning record and cannot be edited.
Cash jobs only. Self-reported figure, never a HomeHero-verified payment.
One invoice per completed booking; cannot be regenerated or edited.

Returns the same stored PDF every time. Provider reaches it from Maheli's Completed Jobs, Client from My Bookings. System Admin is authorised by the backend, but Vihas's SP Tracking UI does not call it yet.
Also invoked by Vihas's admin "Create Account" screen - same routes, same service, same validation.
Same username, email and password on a REJECTED account. Reuses the existing user, so no new token or password hash is created. Capped at 3 attempts.
One shared path for all four roles; Redirect by Role has a destination for each.
